brief.title: Final Project Work: Advanced Programming & Technical Leadership
brief.subtitle: Applied final project for Master Coach National Technical Diploma issuance
brief.description: The Project Work represents the applied capstone assessment of the Personal Trainer Level 3 course. The candidate must submit a comprehensive structured project based on a real or simulated elite client/athlete case, demonstrating high-level assessment, long-term periodization, fatigue management and professional leadership.
rubric: Client/athlete profile, medical history and SMART goal setting
Initial assessment synthesis (F-V profile, postural screening and mobility)
Scientific and biomechanical rationale for exercise selection
Periodized medium- or long-term plan (minimum 6-month timeline)
Load, fatigue and recovery monitoring strategy (HRV, RIR, RPE)
Objective progression, regression and autoregulation criteria
Professional notes, safety considerations, scope-of-practice and legal boundaries
Final outcome review and quantifiable performance metrics
submissionGuidelines: Recommended length: 10 to 20 pages including periodization spreadsheets
Faculty evaluation review window: 5-7 business days

brief.title: Practical Verification: Video Skill Demonstration
brief.subtitle: Technical evaluation of movement standards for Skill Specialist certification
brief.description: To complete the Calisthenics Level 2 Trainer certification, the candidate must submit a video recording demonstrating key required skills in accordance with Libertas/CONI technical guidelines, demonstrating strict alignment, absence of compensations and safety.
rubric: Muscle-Up: fluid, symmetrical transition with zero chicken wing
Front Lever: controlled isometric hold (minimum Advanced Tuck or One Leg for 5s)
Handstand: freestanding balance for at least 10s with stacked line
Planche: controlled straight-arm regression (minimum Tuck Planche for 5s)
Coaching & Spotting: verbal explanation of a progression and safe assistance
submissionGuidelines: Video format: MP4 / MOV or unlisted video link (YouTube/Vimeo/Drive)
Camera angle: lateral and frontal with clear lighting and full body in frame
National technical evaluation review window: 5 business days
